data.name: Kamlesh
data.gender_notes: Kamlesh is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kamlesh is a Sanskrit name derived from two words, ‘Kam’ meaning love and ‘Lesh’ meaning to adorn. It signifies being lovingly adorned with lotus flowers, which is a symbol of purity and divinity in Hindu mythology. The name Kamlesh carries the meaning “Lovingly adorned with lotus” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kamlesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lovingly adorned with lotus and live with faith, good character and purpose.
